# AsyncTask::new behavior in xpcom/rust/moz_task/src/executor.rs

Converts the async-task handle to its fallible form and stores it in the wrapper.

## Result and consumers

AsyncTask owns the fallible handle consumed by polling, detach or cancel.

No local error branch.

## Async completion

Does not itself schedule; callers schedule runnable before constructing wrapper.

## Ownership and cleanup

Moves task handle into wrapper.
